fields.name: Emergency Stop Button Switch (ESTOP)
fields.short_description: The emergency button allows to switch off the sauna heater via the overheating safety circuit. Additionally in an emergency case an alarm via an optional signalling equipment may be triggered, e.g. to draw attention of the supervising staff in a remote location. Please make sure to observe the applicable norms and legal requirements, for instance EN 60335-1, EN 60335-2-53, VDE 0100 part 703 and the requirements of the local energy supplier.
